description: This Java source file defines a Fragment subclass named LogFragment, which manages a user interface component displaying logs within an Android application. It creates and configures a LogView inside a ScrollView, handles text updates, and provides access to the LogView instance.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that displays log output within a scrollable view using a custom LogView.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the ScrollView and LogView components, sets layout parameters, styling, and padding, and returns the ScrollView containing the LogView.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Lifecyle method that inflates the view hierarchy, adds a TextWatcher to auto-scroll on new text, and returns the root view.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Provides external access to the internal LogView instance.
